definitions.explanation: The age of nineteen. In Japan, this is the final year before legal adulthood ({成人|せいじん}) at age 20, though the legal age of majority for most civil-law purposes was lowered to 18 in 2022. Nineteen-year-olds are usually first- or second-year university students, or young workers in their second post–high-school year.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{十九|じゅうきゅう}→十九：00950_juukyuu⟧ (nineteen) and the age counter {〜歳|さい} (years of age).

PRONUNCIATION:
Note the special reading ⟦{十九|じゅうきゅう}→十九：00950_juukyuu⟧ — in isolation, 19 can also be read じゅうく, but for the age compound {十九歳|じゅうきゅうさい}, じゅうきゅう is the standard reading. The ⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧ counter can also be written {才|さい} in informal contexts.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, traditional coming-of-age age is 20, celebrated at ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧ (the Coming-of-Age Ceremony). Since the 2022 civil-code change lowering the age of majority to 18, nineteen-year-olds are adults for most legal purposes, but drinking and smoking remain restricted until 20. In many families, the nineteenth birthday still feels like the last year of "being a kid."
